title: Taxation Bill 2026 Extends Electronics Capital Goods Tax Exemption Sunset to March 31, 2041
summary: Provides 15-year long-term tax predictability for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing hardware.

blocks.text: 🪝 Taxation Bill 2026 Extends Electronics Capital Goods Tax Exemption Sunset to March 31, 2041. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Provides 15-year long-term tax predictability for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing hardware.
Taxation Bill 2026 extends the sunset clause for customs duty exemption on imported capital goods used in electronics manufacturing to **March 31, 2041**.
Supports India's target to build a $500 billion electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on ₹1,27,500 Crore CCEA outlay, 50% fiscal support for silicon fabs, and India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) milestones.
